# W02 · End-to-end field-to-sky replay {#w02-field-to-sky}

The field-to-sky workflow records intermediate field reductions, transformed densities, significance results and sky positions. The Maltese entrances are published **true bearings**. The raw compass and solar-circle observations in this study are separately constructed controls. They do not reconstruct the original instrument notebooks.

| Handoff | Result |
|:---|:---|
| Raw field controls | A target circle of 2.25° and solar circle of 358.75° give 161.23° at the Malta control site. The paired bearings were 161.23° and 141.72°, each matching the independent circle-difference calculation. |
| Mnajdra South | The edges 90.94° and 99.14° sampled skyline heights of 4.40° and 3.45°. The corresponding declinations were +1.71° and −5.48°. The 68% declination HDR comprised −4.75° to −1.95° and −0.90° to +1.00°. |
| Group inference | The replay preserved entrance/profile order for all 17 Ġgantija-phase entrances. The 39-simulation controls exercised both significance routes with fixed inputs and seeds. The package stores the seeded 500-simulation fit. The global p-value is 0.004. The excess from −49.4° to −48.2° has adjusted p = 0.557. The excess from −33.7° to −28.6° has adjusted p = 0.004. |
| Skorba West | Gacrux was returned by the screen for the archived significant band. The modeled heliacal rising date was 14 October 3250 BCE, Julian calendar. On the fifth subsequent morning the terrain crossing was at 03:25:19 UT and azimuth 129.9314°. Twenty minutes later the sketch placed Gacrux at azimuth 132.9934°, altitude 4.2483°, between the entrance edges 128.55° and 138.07° and 2.41° above the recorded skyline. A separate spherical transform at the saved instant reproduced the sketch coordinates. |

**Sensitivity.** Swapping the Mnajdra South and Skorba West profiles changed only the corresponding two mean declinations, by 2.219° and 1.448°. The numeric calculation followed the supplied order, so correct site pairing remains the analyst's responsibility. Rebuilding the PDFs with refraction off shifted their means by 0.146° on average. The seeded random test on the original stored PDFs retained its original results when the session setting changed. A north-crossing density integrated to one. A transformation outside the photographed sector raises a coverage error.

The bundled group result was regenerated from the 17 ordered entrances and their measured widths. Agreement across this workflow establishes numerical continuity of its inputs and outputs. It provides neither a measurement of ancient naked-eye visibility nor evidence of intentional alignment. [Download W02 scripts, per-stage tables](archives/W02.zip).
